announcements.headline: Result of AGM
announcements.insight: This announcement confirms the outcome of a general meeting, which typically involves routine shareholder approvals such as director reappointments or statutory resolutions. It signifies standard corporate governance activity rather than any material change to the company's strategic direction or financial position.

announcements.headline: AGM Statement
announcements.insight: This announcement typically signifies the formal record of proceedings from an Annual General Meeting, including shareholder resolutions and board updates. It serves as a routine governance update rather than a material financial event.

announcements.headline: Contract to Supply Counter Uncrewed Aerial System
announcements.insight: This announcement signifies a new commercial contract for the supply of counter-uncrewed aerial systems, which may indicate business development but lacks details on financial impact or duration.

announcements.headline: Directorate changes
announcements.insight: This announcement signifies a change in the board composition, which may indicate shifts in corporate governance or strategic oversight. Shareholders should monitor subsequent filings to understand the specific roles and potential implications of these directorate changes.

announcements.headline: Final Results
announcements.insight: This announcement signifies the release of final annual results, which is a scheduled regulatory filing providing shareholders with the company's audited financial performance for the period.
